stations.title: Order form
stations.text: Sends every field as text, numbers too.

stations.title: Your types
stations.gap: Text used as if it were numbers

captions: Bryn packs orders at Oakhollow, and the form says the shelf holds 4012 tins.
The form sends every field as text, and the code glues numbers together.
You give each value an honest type and turn the text into numbers.
Now the shelf count adds up, and the compiler would catch the glue.
Every value on the form now says what it is, and the compiler checks it.
